summary: Iter 91b — Tested Executive Summary 'Stock Mix' style_status filter (Active/Retired/All toggle). Backend pytest: 16/16 passed. Frontend e2e: all three data-testids render, default=All highlighted via aria-pressed, clicking Retired/Active triggers refetch with correct style_status param, 'Total on hand' updates to 4,647 (retired) / 70,270 (active) / 74,917 (all), Sold (30d) and Sold% remain constant at 23,952 across all filters (sales unfiltered as designed), Quick Actions & category rows update, combined with window_days 30/60/90 — both params ride along in a single /exec-summary request. Returning to 'All' drops style_status param entirely (default behavior preserved). Live math verified: 70,270 + 4,647 = 74,917 (all = active + retired exactly).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend exec_summary_endpoint (server.py L3243) cleanly threads (country, window_days, style_status) into _stock_mix_block; the filter_rows(annotate_status(...)) pattern is consistent with the same idiom used in /inventory-snapshot, /products, /exports endpoints — good DRY reuse of the merch retired-style list semantics.
stock_mix.style_status echo field is added unconditionally (defaults to 'all' lowercase) which keeps the response shape predictable for the frontend regardless of whether the client sends the param.

Frontend ExecutiveSummary.jsx L1709 has a smart short-circuit: when stockWindowDays===30 AND stockStyleStatus==='all' AND no country, no style_status param is sent — leverages backend default. Verified live: after toggling back to 'All' the URL becomes /exec-summary?window_days=90 (no style_status). Backward-compat win.

StyleStatusToggle component is shared across Inventory/Products/Exports/SOR/Exec — single source of truth for the 3-way pill. Default value prop comment in the component still says "Default in callers should be 'active'" but ExecutiveSummary intentionally overrides to 'all' (which is correct for Exec — leadership wants the full picture by default). The component's internal `v = value || "active"` fallback is never hit here because ExecSummary always passes a value, but it's a latent inconsistency to note.

Sales numbers (subcategory-sales aggregate) are correctly NOT filtered by style_status — verified live: total_sold_units_mtd = 23,952 across all 3 filters. The 'Group cover' weeks figure thus changes dramatically (13.4w / 12.6w / 0.8w) because cover = stock ÷ sold/weeks, and stock changes while sold doesn't. This is an interesting analytical artifact — 'retired stock' shows 0.8w cover meaning retired styles are sold very fast relative to remaining stock, OR conversely it's misleading because the sold-window includes BOTH active+retired sales but stock is retired-only. Worth a tooltip note in a future iteration.
Quick Actions block (markdown candidates count) also updates correctly with the filter: 14 candidates (all) → 13 (active) → 1 (retired). Confirms the filter propagates beyond just the totals header.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 91b feature: 3-way style_status pill on Exec Summary > Stock Mix. testid prefix: exec-stockmix-style-status (-all, -active, -retired). Default value = 'all' (echoed back as stock_mix.style_status). Live measurements: window_days=30 totals stock all=74,917 / active=70,270 / retired=4,647 (sum invariant). Sales (total_sold_units_mtd / total_sold_units_window) are IDENTICAL across all three filters — subcategory-sales is aggregated above the style grain. When user re-selects 'All' the frontend drops the style_status param entirely from the URL (only sends if value !== 'all') — relies on backend default. Combinable with 30/60/90 window selector — both params ride in same request. Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_91b_exec_stockmix_style_status.py — set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before pytest.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified. All 6 acceptance criteria from the review_request verified passing.
